155939.overview:
The situation in the sewers is critical. The rats breed in such numbers that something must be done. The player is picked for the task and he has to go down there and reduce the population. But in the darkness of the sewers also lurk something more dangerous, an angry monster with sentimental feelings toward the rats.

Rat Splat! is a platform game consisting of fixed screen levels. Each level has a number of platforms connected with ladders that the player move between. On the platforms lies cheese that is meant to elicit the rats from their hideouts. As the rats run forth and back across the platforms the player has to move up to them and hit them in the head with his hammer. At the same time the player has to watch out for the monster that tries to hunt down the player. The hammer is not lethal enough for the monster so therefore the player has to switch to an aerosol can to be able to kill it. The cheese has to be protected. When the rats have eaten it all they will stop appearing. To complete a level the player has to kill 15 rats but he can't take to long or he might be overpowered by the cheese smell and die.

175719.overview:
Road Frog is a Frogger clone for the Tangerine Oric computers. It was coded by Philip Hulme and published by Ocean Software in 1983. 

There is the road, the cars and the logs in the river to jump on. The 48K Oric version adds (on higher levels) both a snake, turtles and a crocodile, but still no way to jump back once you've jumped forth.

175838.overview: Four rings the ancient wizards forged and cast upon the Earth. One ring the Evil Sage called forth from the void. Shedir. The Ring of Darkness. May luck travel with all who tread this path.

175868.overview: Rescuing the princess is a three-stage operation in this adventure game - four-stage if you count reading and absorbing the separate instructions program and making notes of the many things you could forget, as there are no paper instructions of any form. First you must reach the castle she is being held in, then search the castle and find her, then take her back to base. Six main instructions are used in the game, selected via the number keys. A map can be called up to show the pattern of the game's layout, with numbers representing particular sections. You can search these, pick up any items you find, and move into adjacent ones. A gun and a radio are the most useful items to find - there are many enemy-occupied locations which will kill you without a gun. The castle can only be reached from one of the 40 squares, and you must find which, and have the right items to cross over to it.

450708.overview: Tennis game for the Oric 1 and Oric Atmos. Programmed by Bernard Aure

458888.overview:
In this game, reminiscent of the original Mario Bros, your rabbit has to catch the tasty carrots that head down the screen. A variety of enemies, mostly types of toadstool, also head down the screen and must be bumped from the platform below to knock them over and leave them stunned. You can then push them off the platforms into the water below.

There are multiple screen layouts and most impressively, two players can play on screen at the same time - just like Mario Bros.  Control takes some getting used to as your rabbit has momentum and must screech to a halt before heading the other way.
